DeployBot: Autorevert triggered for service `runtime` in prod-usw2. Canaries exceeded error threshold (error_rate=5.8% > 3%) for 5m. Deployed tag: release-2026-04-02 (a1b2c3d). Rolling back to release-2026-03-28 (f9e8d7c). Rollback id: rb-2155554321. Initiated by autorevert policy. ETA ~3m.

carol-ng: Ack — I'm watching. Notifying #oncall and the release stakeholders.

raj: +1. After rollback completes, please pin the prior commit and block auto-rollforward for this service. We should avoid another canary until we confirm metrics.

emma: Stopping the canary pipeline now: `ci stop pipeline/runtime-canary`. Disabling scheduled canaries for 30m.

liu-oncall: Oncall looking. Initial traces show OOMs on gpu01 at ~14:21 UTC, container restart loops on canary hosts. Pulling logs and heap dumps.

observability-bot: Alert details: kv-cache miss latency spike -> p95 1200ms, canary error_rate 5.8%. See https://obs.redwood.ai/alerts/2155554321

DeployBot: Rollback in progress — rolling back deployment `runtime` in prod-usw2 to f9e8d7c. Command executed: `deployctl rollback runtime --to f9e8d7c --env prod-usw2`. Rolling back 3 pods (canary + 2 replicas).

carol-ng: If rollback completes cleanly, hold the release and schedule a short triage. Please capture any heap dumps and relevant commit diffs.

liu-oncall: Pushed logs to S3: `s3://redwood-logs/prod-usw2/runtime/2155554321/`. Captured heap dump from gpu01: `heapdump-gpu01-2155554321.hprof`.

DeployBot: Rollback completed at 2155554600. Status: SUCCESS. All runtime pods now running release-2026-03-28 (f9e8d7c). Canary error_rate down to 0.4%, latency returned to baseline. Audit: https://deploy.redwood.ai/rollbacks/rb-2155554321 (includes deploy log and timeline).

emma: Pin applied: `deployctl pin runtime --version f9e8d7c --reason "autorevert after canary spike"`. Registry shows pinned version f9e8d7c for prod.

raj: Thanks. Can we gate unblocking rollforwards until we run the quick regression suite against the pinned version? I'd like the test run green before we re-enable canaries.

carol-ng: Agreed. Holding release and starting a short postmortem doc. Inviting infra, ml-inference, and oncall.

DeployBot: Incident channel will auto-close in 30m if no new errors. :white_check_mark:
